name: load-user-config
body: Load user config: read kalide's per-user settings file into a key-to-value map; resolve one key; write a key (creating the file and its parent directory); unset a key; list the keys. On `set` of `default-template-library` it normalises the value to an absolute path (`~` to the user's home directory, a relative path against the current working directory). Local filesystem only, no network. Realised by solution.component.user-config-store and solution.component.config-command.
